name: no-ticket-comments
description: AI agents paste ticket numbers and long notes into code comments, where they go stale. This hook keeps ticket IDs in commits and pull requests, and limits a comment to a short why.

ticket_prefixes.title: Ticket prefixes
ticket_prefixes.description: Comma-separated tracker keys to block in code comments, such as ENG,OPS. PROJ and TASK are placeholders.

max_comment_lines.title: Max comment lines
max_comment_lines.description: Largest new comment block the hook allows. Use a whole number.
